description: Counts Halcyon board gigs. At the third, sets asc_invited, which unlocks one option on Marcus Broch. Deliberately says NOTHING about the Ascendants — this door is a job that turns into a career, and the whole point is that nobody pitches an ideology at it.

word.text: The clerk at the underwriting desk takes the docket off you, checks something on a screen you can't see, and says — as though it were on the form — "Mr Broch has asked to be told when you were next in. Whenever suits."

name: Halcyon — contracts turned in
